rules.title: Window days validation
rules.statement: Raise exception LMS-031 if p_window_days is null or outside 1-90 inclusive.
rules.notes: Declared parameter is int; no rounding involved.

rules.title: NPA skip
rules.statement: Increment p_skipped and skip loan when asset_class equals 'NPA'.

rules.title: Missing benchmark error
rules.statement: Raise exception LMS-005 when benchmark_code is null on a floating loan.

rules.title: Next reset month calculation
rules.statement: Compute v_months as completed months since disb_date, round down to multiple of reset_months then add one reset_months interval to obtain v_next.
rules.notes: Uses extract(year/month from age); integer division truncates.

rules.title: Reset outside window skip
rules.statement: Skip loan when v_next exceeds p_as_of plus p_window_days.

rules.title: Notice date weekday adjustment
rules.statement: Set v_notice to v_next plus 2 days if Saturday, plus 1 day if Sunday, else unchanged.

rules.title: New rate lookup with missing-value handling
rules.statement: v_new equals most recent benchmark_rate.rate_pct on or before v_next (or 0 if none) plus spread_pct (coalesced to 0).
rules.notes: No declared numeric precision; ORDER BY effective_date DESC LIMIT 1.

rules.title: Old rate lookup with missing-value handling
rules.statement: v_old equals most recent benchmark_rate.rate_pct on or before the prior reset cycle start (or 0 if none) plus spread_pct (coalesced to 0).
rules.notes: Prior cycle date computed as disb_date plus (v_months - reset_months) months.

rules.title: Small rate change skip
rules.statement: Increment p_skipped and skip when absolute difference between v_new and v_old is less than 0.25.

rules.title: Duplicate notice skip
rules.statement: Increment p_skipped and skip when a RESET_NOTICE entry already exists whose note starts with 'reset ' followed by v_next.
rules.notes: Uses LIKE pattern on note column.

rules.title: Insert reset notice
rules.statement: Insert loan_ledger row with entry_type RESET_NOTICE, amount = v_new, entry_date = v_notice, and note containing the reset details; increment p_posted.

contradictions.description: Header claims fixed 30-day window; code accepts variable p_window_days (1-90).

open_questions: Confirm that missing benchmark rates are intentionally treated as 0 rather than raising an error.
Confirm that rate comparison uses strict < 0.25 and numeric equality without rounding or scale specification.
Confirm that duplicate detection relies solely on the note text pattern rather than a dedicated flag column.
